As IHG's biggest hotel brand, we're first choice for the increasing number of travelers who need a simple, engaging place to rest, recharge and get a little work done. We offer everything guests need and provide more where it matters most.THE POSITIONAs a Cook, you will take on a high level of responsibility, ensuring our guests start their day with a great breakfast experience. Our hotel has 160 rooms, breakfast is included for every guest, and we daily serve group lunches and dinners. The ideal candidate is a great organizer, works in a fast pace and is a real team player. You work closely with the F&B team and report to the Operations Manager.This is a position for 15.2 hours on a weekly basis. YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES• Prepare and maintain the breakfast buffet with hot and cold dishes • Prepare group lunch and dinner• Monitor food quality, freshness and hygiene standards (HACCP)• Maintain a clean and organized kitchen• Daily ordering of supplies with different suppliers• Collaborating with other departments to ensure smooth running of the kitchenWHAT YOU'LL BRING • Being able to work independently in the kitchen• Having a creative and warm personality and knowing how to connect with everyone.• Guest-oriented and representative.• Speaking excellent English, the Dutch language is a plus.• Experience in hotel settings is a plus.Functie-eisen:ABOUT ODYSSEYWe are The Odyssey Hotel Group, Europe's most ambitious hotel operator and the team behind many famous global hospitality names. We partner with Marriott, IHG, and Accor to develop exceptional properties across various brands, from Holiday Express to Marriott's Autograph collection. - Horst - €2.600,- tot €3.000,- p.m. - 2 ploegendienst Take the next step in your career as a reach truck operator! A friendly and approachable company in the Horst area is looking for a full-time reach truck operator to start immediately. Work independently, put your accuracy and safety skills to use, and contribute to a smooth-running warehouse alongside your colleagues. A two-shift system is part of the job, offering variety in your working hours. Functieomschrijving What will you do as a reach truck operator? - Operate the reach truck and safely move goods around the warehouse. - Pick and pack orders. - Carry out basic administrative tasks. - Work together with colleagues to keep the warehouse running smoothly. Functievereisten What are we looking for? - You hold a valid reach truck certificate. - You have your own transport to get to work in Horst. - You can communicate in basic English with your colleagues. - You are willing to work a two-shift system. Arbeidsvoorwaarden What do we offer you? - €2,600-€3,000 gross per month. - A 33% allowance for every hour worked beyond 40 hours per week. - A friendly and informal working environment. - Opportunities for personal growth and professional development. Ready to start working as a reach truck operator in a modern warehouse and contribute to an organisation with a meaningful purpose? Apply now and you could soon be joining the team in Horst!  Vragen? Onze specialisten staan je graag te woord.  Lucas van Helvoort -  Frederik van Eedenstraat 1 Venlo Limburg 5921 BE Nederland Routebeschrijving - lucas.vanhelvoort@wolframchain.nl - +31 772042000 - Horst - €2.600,- tot €3.000,- p.m.
